record.label: Phase 1 to Phase 2 migration audit
record.summary: Separated reusable mathematics from stale empirical choices. CP3/TT3 and K21 identities transfer; ranks, caps, learned weights, layer schedules, splits, meters, and raw trajectories do not. The old rank-22 dense PSD host screens about 9.64% over budget under algebraic scaling, identifying the first redesign target without claiming a flopscope receipt.
record.terminal_criterion: Treat every Phase 1 empirical parameter and score as an initialization hypothesis only; promotion requires a fresh Phase 2 meter and held-out gate.
